اؤتمنا (form VIII)
# اُؤْتُمِنَا (uʔtuminā) /uʔ.tu.mi.naː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# اُؤْتُمِنَّا (uʔtuminnā) /uʔ.tu.min.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
